'''Tan-Tek's Roast-Basted Bantha Ribs''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] stand located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was close to [[Docking Bay 99]].
